fonts.display: 'Primary Font', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Custom geometric sans (sphere-like, soft terminals)', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary text, all heading and body color, dominant border color, nav text and structural dividers. The near-black (not pure black) keeps the monochrome system from feeling harsh against white

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, icon fills on dark backgrounds, nav pill surface when over light sections

palette.name: Mist Gray
palette.role: Secondary text, subheadings, muted body copy, lighter hairline borders. The middle step in the achromatic scale

palette.name: Smoke Gray
palette.role: Nav link text at rest, medium-weight borders, tertiary text

palette.name: Veil Gray
palette.role: Lightest border tone for link underlines, subtle dividers between content blocks

palette.name: Periwinkle Glow
palette.role: The sole chromatic accent — fills the SIGN IN button and the floating nav container. Soft violet at moderate saturation; it reads as illuminated rather than branded, so the entire UI feels switched-on when it appears
